notes.title: Katana Rama is part of SXSW Sydney 2024 Official Selection!!
notes.notes:
Happy to announce that Katana Rama is part of SXSW Sydney Games 2024 Lineup! We want to thank SXSW Sydney for their generous inclusion!   

As always we can't reach the more people without the help of our community. So thank you for supporting Katana Rama for as long as you have. 

For new comers, Katana Rama is now 50% off on Steam in conjunction with Steam Summer Sale 2024! (Until July 11 2024) Get yours now! : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1944630/Katana_Rama/

Other than that, We will be attending SXSW Sydney 2024 physically this Oct. We will update more details on that when the date draws closer. 

Thank you!

notes.title: Free Content Update: V1.01
notes.notes:
[b]v1.01 Hard Mode Patch[/b]
Changes
[list]
[*] - Added Chinese (Traditional and Simplified) localization
[*] - [b]Added Hard Mode[/b]
                 	- Energy level resets to 0 when taken damage
                	- Chain attacking combo counter
                	- New scoring system 
                	- New Boss abilities
[*] - Improved score display
[*] - Improved tutorial level
[*] - Added a new Hidden Boss
[/list]

Bug fixes
[list]
[*] - Fixed attack hitbox stays active after dashing/double jumping mid air attack
[*] - Fixed issue with lock on near Boss arena wall
[*] - Fixed player sometimes gaining Energy twice from a single enemy kill
[*] - Fixed transparent energy pop up letter stuck on screen
[*] - Fixed dash attack sometimes doesn't connect
[*] - Fixed camera poking out ceiling
[*] - Fixed player sliding or sinking into ground in cutscene
[*] - Fixed hint not showing properly with teleporter
[*] - Fixed Level 02 BGM out of sync
[*] - "Point" is now reworded to "Energy"
[*] - Enemy now respawns in certain area to prevent softlock
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Award Nomination for Best Soundtrack!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
looking at the nomination categories for Steam Award Nominations, not gonna lie we have don't really know if we're good enough for any of them ːsteamsadː . But one category that we're quite confidant at is the Best Soundtrack category. If you've enjoyed our game's soundtrack (produced by the talented Owlscillate and perform by the one and only Zephyrianna) Do consider nominating us for the Best Soundtrack category for this year's Steam Awards!
